newsitem.title: RUSSIA: LOMO swings into Jan-Sept net loss.
newsitem.headline: LOMO swings into Jan-Sept net loss.

text.p: NOTE - Full name OAO Leningradskoye Optiko-Mekhanicheskoye Obyedineniye LOMO. Inros-Capital owns 20 percent.

Spokesman Lazar Zalmanov attributed the loss to a revaluation of the company's basic funds, increased amortisation rates for basic funds, and increased operating costs reflecting more expensive raw materials and energy prices.
The figures are prepared according to Russian accounting standards.
Figures are not adjusted for inflation or the depreciation of the rouble, but the following data may be helpful.
Dollar on Moscow Interbank Currency Exchange (MICEX):
Consumer prices in September 1996 were 16.5 percent higher than in December 1995. In September 1995 they were 104.7 percent higher than in December 1994.
